title: Explain architecture without repeating the full context
prompt: Explain how data-kb works, what it is built with, what inputs it has, and how it persists data. Give a brief but complete answer.
success_criteria: Includes at least 6 of the 8 expected facts
Does not claim Django/FastAPI as the main framework

title: Decide whether to migrate data-kb to another language
prompt: Tell me whether it is worth migrating data-kb to another language or whether it is better to first improve its internal architecture. Justify the recommendation.
expected_facts: Python is still reasonable for memory/AI/data
a full migration is not the first step
Go only if distribution/single-binary is a priority
Rust only if extreme performance/safety requires it
success_criteria: Does not base the decision on a single metric

title: Design a reliable benchmark
prompt: Design a benchmark to find out whether data-kb saves tokens, stores useful memory, and retrieves correct memory without scope leaks.

title: Resolve an architecture contradiction
prompt: I have contradictory information: one memory says data-kb uses Django, another says it uses neither Django nor FastAPI, and another says it will migrate to FastAPI next week. What should I consider current?
expected_facts: The active memory M017 corrects M016
M018 is temporary/future and must not be treated as the current state
The answer must express caution if external confirmation is missing
success_criteria: Does not claim Django is current
Does not claim FastAPI is already current

title: Audit memory capture
prompt: Review these candidate memories and tell me which should be saved, edited, or rejected: a stable user preference, a fake API key, today's temporary data, a current technical decision, and an obsolete decision.
expected_facts: A stable preference may be saved
An API key must be rejected
Temporary data must not persist as project memory
A current decision may be saved
An obsolete decision must be marked deprecated/superseded

title: Prioritized improvement plan
prompt: Prioritize the most important improvements for data-kb after the benchmark. Focus on quality, security, and reliability.
success_criteria: Prioritizes security and scopes at the top
Does not propose a full rewrite as the first step
